title: Q3 Staggered On‑Prem & VPC Adoption Playbook for Private Deployments
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Purpose: Create an actionable playbook and acceptance criteria for a staggered Q3 adoption of Private (VPC + on‑prem) deployments by enterprise customers. The playbook will operationalize tranche-based onboarding, compatibility gates, automation for installer/upgrade flows, and SLAs/rollback policies so Sales & Success can confidently ship to large regulated customers with predictable timelines.

Scope:
- Tranche cohort definitions (Alpha/Beta/General Availability) with gate criteria
- Preflight checklist for customer environments (network, KMS, HSM, metrics collection)
- Installer automation and idempotent upgrade steps for on‑prem packages and VPC private control plane
- Compatibility matrix for OS, container runtime, GPU drivers, and kernel/quantization variants
- Rollout governance: canary rules, SLO targets, rollback triggers, and communication templates
- OKR alignment and metrics collection for onboard velocity and reliability

Out of scope: full infra billing model changes, deep runtime code rework (will file ENG followups), new product features beyond installation and rollout governance.
acceptance_criteria: Defined three tranche cohorts (Alpha, Beta, GA) with explicit entry/exit criteria
Preflight checklist document + automated preflight script validated on two customer environments
Installer/upgrade runbook with automated health checks and idempotent steps in repo
Compatibility matrix published and linked in Console onboarding UI
Rollout governance flow documented with canary thresholds and rollback playbook
Dashboards emitting onboarding progress metrics (time-to-first-request, token throughput baseline, MTR)
Sign-off from Security, Reliability, and Solutions Engineering on playbook and runbooks
okrs: OKR-PD-2026-Q3: Reduce average private deployment onboarding time from 12 weeks to 6 weeks
OKR-Reliability-2026-Q3: Achieve MTR <= 4 hours for deployment incidents during GA rollouts
OKR-GTM-2026-Q3: Increase closed-won conversion rate for regulated accounts by 20% for customers scoped to private deployment
